job.title: 26045P | Interim Sustainability Business Controller (4 days a week) | Global Manufacturer
job.description:
For an international manufacturing company, we are seeking an Interim Sustainability Business Controller to strengthen sustainability performance management, financial planning, investment governance, and ESG reporting across the organisation.

This is a hands-on interim role at the intersection of sustainability, finance, and business performance. The mandate is to bring greater financial discipline and transparency to sustainability initiatives, ensuring that ESG ambitions are translated into measurable performance, robust investment decisions, and actionable management insights.


Key responsibilities

  • Drive sustainability performance management, monitoring ESG KPIs and progress against strategic sustainability targets
  • Manage and enhance Scope 1, 2 and 3 carbon accounting, including performance against SBTi commitments
  • Support CSRD / ESRS-compliant ESG reporting, data governance, internal controls, and external assurance processes
  • Integrate sustainability into budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and performance management
  • Develop, review, and challenge business cases for sustainability investments, ensuring both financial and strategic value
  • Coordinate and monitor sustainability-related OPEX and CAPEX plans, providing transparency on investment, spend, and value realisation
  • Partner with Business Units and OpCos to develop investment proposals, assess financial impact, and embed sustainability into business decision-making
  • Track the financial and operational value generated by sustainability initiatives and identify opportunities for performance improvement
  • Ensure high-quality ESG data, dashboards, analysis, and management reporting
  • Establish and strengthen internal controls, processes, and data governance around sustainability information
  • Translate sustainability performance and ESG data into clear, actionable insights for senior management
  • Support wider organisational change by embedding sustainability considerations into financial and operational processes


Profile

  • Approximately 5–8+ years’ experience within Sustainability Controlling, ESG Reporting, Finance/Business Controlling, or Corporate Sustainability
  • Strong understanding of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management
  • Proven experience with CSRD / ESRS reporting, ESG data governance, and sustainability reporting processes
  • Experience with carbon accounting across Scope 1, 2 and 3, ideally including the GHG Protocol and SBTi target management
  • Demonstrated experience in developing or evaluating business cases for sustainability investments
  • Experience managing or tracking sustainability-related OPEX and CAPEX portfolios
  • Strong business-partnering skills, with experience supporting Business Units or operating companies on investment and performance decisions
  • Comfortable translating ESG and sustainability objectives into financial and operational metrics
  • Strong analytical capability and experience with reporting and analytics tools such as SAP, Power BI, and Excel
  • Experience operating within a multinational, matrix organisation
  • Experience within animal nutrition, agriculture, manufacturing, or a related industrial environment is an advantage
  • Experience supporting external assurance, audit, and internal control processes for ESG reporting
  • Hands-on, structured, commercially minded, and delivery-focused
  • Fluent in English


﻿Practical details

  • Interim assignment: 3–6 months
  • 4 days per week
  • Hybrid working model
  • Immediate availability required

job.title: 26043 | Senior Manager Inside Sales | Leading International Intralogistics Solutions Provider
job.description:
The Organization 

For one of our clients, a leading international provider of intralogistics solutions, material handling equipment, warehouse automation and related services, we are searching for a Senior Manager Inside Sales to further develop the internal commercial organization in the Netherlands. 

The Dutch organization is a profitable and well-established sales and service business with ambitious growth plans towards 2030. To support the next phase of development, the company is creating a new Senior Manager Inside Sales position, bringing the different internal sales teams together under one leadership structure and further strengthening collaboration, process efficiency and digitalization. 


The Role 

As Senior Manager Inside Sales, you will lead and further develop the internal sales organization and ensure that it provides a strong, proactive and efficient commercial backbone to the wider Sales organization. 

A key objective is to enable the field sales teams to spend more time with customers by strengthening the supporting commercial and administrative processes. At the same time, the new leadership structure will allow the Director Sales to reduce his span of control and focus more strongly on strategy execution and key accounts. 

You will bring the different internal sales teams closer together, create clear ownership and improve end-to-end collaboration across areas such as customer data, calculations, quotations, sales support and order preparation. 

In addition, you will drive process improvement and digitalization, making better use of existing systems, data and digital tools while preparing the organization for future developments. The role requires close collaboration with Outside Sales, Key Account Management, Marketing, Order Realization and international Group functions. 


The Ideal Candidate 


Experiences 

  • 7+ years of relevant professional experience in Inside Sales, Sales Operations or a comparable commercial B2B environment, including at least 3 years of people leadership experience.  
  • Strong understanding of commercial and administrative sales processes, including quotations, calculations, customer data, sales support and order preparation.  
  • Proven experience in leading and developing teams and creating stronger ownership, accountability and collaboration.  
  • Experience improving commercial processes and using systems, data and digital tools to increase efficiency and effectiveness.  
  • Ability to combine commercial understanding with a strong operational and administrative backbone, ideally in an organization with a sizeable field sales force.  
  • Experience working cross-functionally and collaborating with central or international functions.  
  • Experience in an operationally complex B2B environment; experience in logistics, intralogistics or industrial equipment is considered an advantage. 
  • Exposure to ERP, CRM or broader systems transformation is considered an advantage.  

Skills 

  • Commercially minded and improvement-oriented. Understands what helps a sales organization perform better and looks for practical ways to simplify processes, improve cooperation and increase efficiency.  
  • Quick learner with strong adaptability. Gets up to speed quickly in new environments and is comfortable working with unfamiliar products, systems and business contexts.  
  • Proactive and action-oriented. Takes initiative, addresses issues directly and moves topics forward without waiting for others to take the lead.  
  • Strong and engaging people leader. Creates clarity, develops employees and builds a team culture based on ownership, collaboration and accountability.  
  • Digitally confident and curious. Sees technology as an enabler for better ways of working and is keen to make effective use of systems, data and new tools.  
  • Positive and collaborative. Builds constructive relationships across teams and functions, brings energy to change and is able to create alignment between different stakeholders.  
  • Structured and pragmatic. Keeps overview in a complex environment, sets priorities and turns ideas into practical and sustainable execution.  


Language Requirements 

  • Fluency in Dutch and English.  
  • German language skills are considered an advantage.  

﻿

Interested? 

Please submit your CV in English . Reference and diploma checks are a standard part of the procedure; assessments and pre-employment screening may also be included

job.title: 26036 Global Supply Chain Director | High-Tech Electronics Manufacturer
job.description:
The Organization

For an international high-tech electronics manufacturer with operations across Europe and Asia, we are searching for a Global Supply Chain Director.


As the business becomes increasingly international and integrated, the organisation is further developing its global supply-chain model, with a particular focus on planning, S&OP, capacity management, inventory and cross-site coordination.


The Role

The Global Supply Chain Director will take overall responsibility for the quality and execution of supply-chain planning across the group. Reporting directly to the Executive Board, you will define and implement a consistent global approach to demand planning, S&OP, production and capacity planning, supplier forecasting, inventory management and operational procurement.


A key priority will be bringing demand and supply together across multiple manufacturing locations, balancing customer requirements with available capacity, component availability, inventory, working capital and cost. You will also lead the further development of S&OP and master production scheduling and drive stronger coordination between the operating companies.

The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on implementation and requires close cooperation with local supply-chain teams across the international organisation.


The Ideal Candidate

Experience

  • Senior supply-chain leadership experience within an international, multi-site manufacturing environment.
  • Strong background in complex high-tech manufacturing.
  • Proven experience developing and implementing S&OP, demand planning and production planning across multiple sites.
  • Strong understanding of forecasting, inventory, planning parameters, supplier lead times and capacity management.
  • Experience managing inventory and working capital while maintaining customer delivery performance.
  • Proven ability to lead through a matrix organisation and create alignment across multiple operating companies.
  • Experience with ERP systems, planning tools and data-driven supply-chain management.

Skills

  • Strategic yet highly pragmatic supply-chain leader.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across both executive and operational levels.
  • Able to challenge forecasts and assumptions and make decisions in complex or changing environments.
  • Entrepreneurial and improvement-oriented, with the ability to build structures in an evolving organisation.
  • Commercially aware, with a strong understanding of the relationship between planning, customer delivery, cost and working capital.
  • Fluent English required; additional European languages are advantageous.

job.title: 26031 | Sourcing Lead | Multinational B2B Industrial Distributor
job.description:
The Organization

For one of our clients, a well-established multinational B2B industrial distributor with operations across Europe and Asia-Pacific, we are searching for a Sourcing Lead to join their Global Procurement organization.


The company combines large-scale technical distribution with deep application expertise and integrated service solutions, serving a broad range of industrial end markets. Following a significant transformation of its procurement function, the organization has recently centralized its sourcing activities and is entering the next phase of its strategic development, with a clear focus on supplier consolidation, category management, and measurable value creation.


The Role

As Sourcing Lead, you will take ownership of the global sourcing strategy for one of the company's key product categories. You will lead a small team of Procurement Managers and work in close partnership with Product Group Management to align sourcing strategy with commercial and assortment priorities.


You will drive supplier consolidation, lead negotiations with strategic partners, and support the development of the supplier base across both established and emerging sourcing geographies. Beyond category ownership, you will play an active role in the broader procurement transformation, elevating team capabilities and contributing directly to EBITDA performance.


The position is based at one of the company's locations in the Netherlands, either in the Alkmaar or Roermond area. A hybrid working model applies, with a limited amount of international travel.


The Ideal Candidate

Experience

  • 8–12 years of experience in strategic procurement or category management within an industrial, technical, or manufacturing environment.
  • Proven track record managing significant spend responsibility within a structured category management framework.
  • Demonstrated experience in supplier negotiation, supplier consolidation, and strategic sourcing across international supply bases.
  • Experience leading and developing a small team of procurement professionals.
  • Familiarity working within an international matrix organization and collaborating across commercial and operational functions.


Skills

  • Strategic sourcing mindset. Able to develop and execute category strategies that deliver sustainable commercial value.
  • Strong negotiation skills. Structured and confident in managing complex, multi-geography supplier relationships.
  • Leadership and coaching ability. Capable of developing team members at varying levels of seniority and raising the overall standard of procurement execution.
  • Business partnership orientation. Effective at working alongside product management, sales, and operations to ensure sourcing and commercial strategy are developed in close alignment.
  • Analytical and data-driven. Uses spend analysis, supplier performance data, and market intelligence to support decision-making.
  • Change-oriented mindset. Comfortable contributing to a function undergoing meaningful transformation and professionalization.


Language Requirements

  • Fluency in English is required.
  • Dutch is considered a advantage

job.title: 26027 | Country Manager Benelux | Leading European Professional Lighting Solutions Provider
job.description:
The Organization

For one of our clients, a leading European premium provider of professional lighting and smart building solutions, we are searching for a Country Manager Benelux to lead and further develop their organization across the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg.


The company has a strong heritage in high-quality, sustainable and energy-efficient lighting solutions for professional indoor and outdoor environments. The Benelux organization is mature and profitable, with a strong position in the Dutch premium lighting market and clear growth potential in Belgium, Retail and Smart Lighting.


The role

As Country Manager Benelux, you will be responsible for the overall business performance and continued development of the Benelux organization. The role combines strategic market development with hands-on commercial leadership, senior customer engagement and people leadership.


You will drive sustainable growth by translating the broader brand strategy into a clear local go-to-market approach, increasing early project involvement with key stakeholders and strengthening the company’s position in specification-led project business. In addition, you will further develop growth areas, while continuing to build and empower a mature local team.


The Ideal Candidate

Experiences

  • 10+ years of commercial experience in B2B project sales, business development or country / regional management within lighting, building technology, building products, construction-related industries or a comparable specification-led environment.
  • 5+ years of senior people leadership experience, ideally with responsibility for a P&L, country, region, commercial organization or business unit.
  • Strong understanding of project-driven, multi-stakeholder sales processes, including early engagement with architects, consultants, installers, end users, project developers and other key project stakeholders.
  • Experience with premium technical solutions, value-based selling and commercial performance management.
  • Previous exposure to P&L responsibility, budgeting, forecasting and business reviews.
  • Experience working within an international organization and collaborating with regional or headquarters functions.
  • Exposure to Smart Lighting, smart building solutions, connected technologies or sustainability-driven propositions is considered an advantage.


Skills

  • Commercially strong and growth-oriented. Able to identify market opportunities and translate them into clear priorities and focused execution.
  • Market-facing and customer-oriented. Builds long-term relationships with key stakeholders and enjoys being close to customers and the business.
  • Strategic and pragmatic. Sets direction while remaining hands-on and practical in execution.
  • Strong people leader. Coaches, develops and empowers teams while creating ownership and accountability.
  • Structured and performance-oriented. Uses pipeline management, forecasting, KPIs and financial insight to steer commercial performance.
  • Collaborative and communicative. Builds trust across local, regional and international stakeholders and contributes to an open, inclusive and performance-oriented culture.


Language Requirements

  • Fluency in Dutch and English.
  • Knowledge of French is considered an advantage.


Interested?

Please submit your  CV in English. Reference and diploma checks are a standard part of the procedure; assessments and pre-employment screening may also be included.

job.title: 26009 | Associate Partner | Kienbaum Netherlands (Amsterdam)
job.description:
Entrepreneurial. International. Impactful.

At Kienbaum, we are a progress company — for people, for organizations, and for the future. Founded in 1945, we are one of Europe’s leading HR consultancies, combining Executive Search, Leadership Advisory, and Board Services. With over 80 years of experience and a presence in more than 20 countries, we empower people and organizations to thrive in tomorrow’s professional world.


About Kienbaum Netherlands

Our Amsterdam office, established in 2004, is home to an international and close-knit team that combines professionalism with entrepreneurship, energy, and humor. We work across sectors such as Industrial, High-Tech, Technology, Building & Construction, Defence & Security and ESG/Sustainability, serving a diverse client base of family-owned businesses, private equity and venture capital firms, scale-ups, and (mid-sized) multinationals.

In addition to Executive Search, we offer Leadership Assessment & Development, Board Services, and Interim Executives, supported by a high-quality research team and an advanced AI-driven workflow system. Our culture is defined by collaboration, trust, personal growth, and shared ambition — and yes, we believe in enjoying the work (our office gym helps too!).


The Role

We are seeking an Associate Partner — a driven and entrepreneurial professional who will build and lead their own practice area, contribute to the growth of our organization, and inspire clients and colleagues alike.

You will:

  • Develop your own client portfolio and market domain within preferable complementary growth areas.
  • Lead Executive Search assignments from start to finish — from business development and client advisory to candidate identification, assessment, and placement.
  • Collaborate closely with our research and consulting teams to deliver tailored, high-quality solutions.
  • Contribute to Kienbaum’s broader portfolio, including Assessments, Board Services, and Leadership Advisory.
  • Participate in international practice groups and share insights across our global network.

This is a role for someone who enjoys autonomy, values teamwork, and thrives in a dynamic, intellectually challenging, and people-cantered environment.


Who You Are

  • Experienced: Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience, including at least 5 years in executive search or consultancy.
  • Entrepreneurial: You identify opportunities, act on them, and build lasting client relationships.
  • Commercially strong: Proven success in winning and managing client assignments.
  • Well-connected: A broad network at senior management or board level within the Dutch business community.
  • Linguistically proficient: Fluency in Dutch and English, both written and verbal, is mandatory.
  • Internationally minded: Experience working in multicultural environments.
  • Authentic and inspiring: You combine professional excellence with warmth, humor, and curiosity.


What We Offer

  • A partnership opportunity within one of Europe’s top HR consultancies (Top 5 in Europe, Top 10 globally).
  • Access to Kienbaum’s strong international brand, network, and tools, including the Kienbaum Academy for continuous learning.
  • The freedom to build your own business domain within a respected and well-established firm.
  • A hybrid work environment with flexibility, autonomy, and an inspiring office culture in Amsterdam.
  • A team that celebrates success together — from strategy sessions to summer parties.

If you’re ready to take ownership, grow your own practice, and help leaders and organizations progress, we’d love to meet you.


Interested?

Please apply via the ‘Apply’ button and submit your CV in English (preferred in PDF format), and application letter if desired.

Reference and diploma checks are standard part of the procedure; assessment, background checks and pre-employment screening may also be part of the procedure.

job.title: 26010 | Internship (WO) Executive Search & HR Consultancy
job.description:
Wil jij begrijpen hoe leiders op C-level worden geselecteerd en daar zelf inhoudelijk aan bijdragen?


Tijdens je internship bij Kienbaum Nederland werk je na je onboarding mee aan Executive Search-opdrachten en krijg je inzicht in hoe organisaties leiderschap en talent op topniveau beoordelen.

Dit is geen stage vanaf de zijlijn, maar een inhoudelijk internship waarin je echt onderdeel bent van het team.


Kienbaum

Kienbaum is een internationaal adviesbureau in Executive Search, Board Advisory en Leadership Advisory, met 24 kantoren in 18 landen. Al meer dan 80 jaar ondersteunen we organisaties bij vraagstukken rond leiderschap, talent en transformatie.

In Amsterdam werk je in een klein en betrokken team dat organisaties begeleidt bij het aantrekken en ontwikkelen van leiders. Juist doordat ons team compact is, krijg je veel mee, werk je direct samen met ervaren collega’s en lever je vanaf het begin een echte inhoudelijke bijdrage.


De rol

In deze rol werk je mee aan Executive Search-opdrachten en ondersteun je daarnaast bij evaluatie- en business development-projecten. Het werk bestaat uit het in kaart brengen van markten, research naar organisaties en kandidaten en het ondersteunen bij de voorbereiding en uitvoering van lopende opdrachten.

De werkzaamheden zijn afwisselend en combineren research, analyse en projectondersteuning. Denk aan desk research, data-invoer, het opstellen van longlists en de voorbereiding van interne overleggen, waarbij je ook werkt met AI en automatiseringen. Naarmate je zelfstandiger wordt, krijg je meer verantwoordelijkheid en word je actiever betrokken bij de inhoud van opdrachten.

Leren gebeurt in deze rol vooral in de praktijk: door nauw samen te werken met ervaren collega’s, gerichte begeleiding te krijgen en stap voor stap meer verantwoordelijkheid op te bouwen.


De ideale kandidaat 

We zoeken een nieuwsgierige, zelfstandige student die scherp analyseert, graag uitzoekt hoe organisaties en markten in elkaar zitten en energie krijgt van inhoudelijk werk en de lat qua kwaliteit hoog legt. Iemand die gestructureerd werkt, makkelijk schakelt tussen verschillende taken en het leuk vindt om in een klein team nauw samen te werken.

Beschikbaarheid voor 4 tot 5 dagen per week gedurende 5 tot 6 maanden is voor deze rol belangrijk. Natuurlijk houden we rekening met drukke studieperiodes. Voor studenten die goed passen binnen het team en het werk, kan dit internship een mooie opstap zijn naar een verdere rol binnen Kienbaum.


 Achtergrond en Ervaringen

  • Universitaire studie, bijvoorbeeld in HR, Bedrijfskunde, Psychologie, Geschiedenis, Antropologie, Rechten, Communicatie of AI
  • Relevante ervaring via stages, bijbanen of nevenactiviteiten
  • Interesse in organisaties, leiderschap en hoe bedrijven zijn ingericht
  • Goede vaardigheden in MS Office, waaronder Outlook, Excel, Word en PowerPoint en werken met AI.
  • Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels; Duits is een pré
  • Internationale ervaring is mooi meegenomen


 Persoonlijke vaardigen

  • Nieuwsgierigheid, scherpte en analytisch vermogen
  • Zorgvuldigheid en oog voor kwaliteit
  • Vermogen om prioriteiten te stellen en overzicht te houden
  • Initiatief en heldere communicatie
  • Flexibiliteit en een vlotte manier van schakelen
  • Zelfstandigheid én de bereidheid om nauw samen te werken


Spreekt jou dit aan?

Solliciteren dan direct. We vragen we je om je cv te uploaden en een korte motivatie in te vullen.

Een assessment is onderdeel van de sollicitatieprocedure. Ook kunnen referenties en diploma’s worden gecheckt.

job.title: 26002 | Join our Network / Interim Executives and Interim Professionals

Interim Executives

Short-term coverage of executive vacancies or temporary management (General Management, Finance, Tax & Legal, Risk &Compliance, Sales & Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain & Logistics, Engineering, Human Resource and ICT)


Interim Professionals

  • Functional Experts and Specialists such as Recruiters, Project Managers and Legal Counsels

Personal Skills

  • A talent for people and change management


Interested?
